item.title: At least 139 dead as migrant boat from Djibouti to Yemen capsizes
item.description:
At least 139 migrants, including 15 children, died when a boat carrying more than 300 people capsized off the coast of Djibouti, according to the United Nations' migration agency. The vessel was carrying 305 people from Djibouti toward Yemen when it capsized Thursday night or early Friday near Guhere, north of Obock, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said Sunday. At least 84 people remained missing as of Sunday, while more than 80 survived. All of the survivors were Ethiopian nationals , according to the agency. "No one gets into a boat like that unless they believe there is no other safe way," IOM Director General Amy Pope said in a statement. item.title: Leaders from India's 'Cockroach' movement released from detention, pledge to hold more protests
item.description:
Authorities impose strict lockdown in capital to try to stop rally against removal of 130m names from electoral roll Indian authorities have placed Delhi under a severe lockdown and detained tens of thousands of people, including the leader of the youth-led “Cockroach” movement, in an attempt to stop an anti-government protest. Thousands of people from across India were blocked from attending the demonstration, which had been called by the “Cockroach Janata party” (CJP) to protest against an exercise that has stripped 130m names from India’s electoral roll. item.title: Scores of gold miners killed in air strikes on Egypt-Sudan border, rights group says
item.description:
At least 72 workers were killed in air strikes on a gold mine on the Sudan-Egypt border on Saturday, a Sudanese rights group said on Sunday. The Emergency Lawyers organisation accused Egypt’s air force of the attack. AFP could not independently verify the account and Egypt has issued no official comment.

Covered by 5 public.
Sources: Al Jazeera English, BBC News, Deutsche Welle, France 24

item.title: UK PM Andy Burnham says it is ‘clear’ Russia interfered in 2016 Brexit vote
item.description:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Sunday warned French and German voters of potential for Russian influence in upcoming elections, on the back of "clear" interference in Britain's referendum on European Union membership in 2016. Russia has previously denied meddling in the Brexit vote, while former British leader Boris Johnson 2020 also said there was no evidence of interference. Burnham made the comments in an interview with The Rest is Politics podcast, released on Sunday.

Sources: ABC News, Al Jazeera English, Deutsche Welle, France 24

item.title: Hurricane Isaias leaves trail of destruction across the US Gulf Coast
item.description:
Boarding up windows and filling sandbags and fuel tanks are part of routine hurricane preparation for residents of the Gulf coast. Isaias strengthened into a category 3 hurricane on Friday morning as it barreled toward the US Gulf coast, and states of emergency have been declared in Alabama, Florida and Mississippi. Isaias is forecast to make landfall on Friday night, somewhere along the Alabama-Florida line, with surging seas up to 7ft (2.1 meters) and waves as high as 30ft Hurricane Isaias barrels toward Gulf coast as category 3 storm Isaias strengthens to become first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 season Continue reading...
